goal: Provide a controlled, audited, read-only automation boundary for configured Obsidian vault roots before any obsidian-cli or defuddle execution is allowed.

acceptance_criteria.description: The Obsidian vault automation contract is valid, has unique criteria IDs, and records Phase 1 as read-only with deferred write execution.
The wrapper only allows configured vault roots and rejects unconfigured absolute paths.
The wrapper blocks path traversal and symlink escapes outside the configured vault root.
Read-only operations support list, read, search, metadata, and frontmatter without shell execution.
Write, delete, and shell execution requests are denied; proposed write actions remain dry-run only and create audit records.
Every allowed, denied, and dry-run operation records an append-only audit entry with timestamp, actor, operation, path, allowed, dry_run, reason, and payload fields.
The runtime tool is registered as a gated builtin tool and is exposed only when provider_settings.obsidian_vault_automation.enabled is true.
The runtime tool requires configured vault roots and returns a friendly error when no root is configured.
The runtime tool exposes only list, read, search, metadata, and frontmatter operations through the controlled wrapper.
The runtime tool rejects write, delete, shell, obsidian-cli, and defuddle-style operations without invoking any shell adapter.
Write planning returns a dry-run plan with plan_id, action, risk, expiry, content hashes, and unified diff without modifying vault files.
Write planning supports new-file creation plans without creating the target file.
Write planning enforces configured plan byte limits and audits denied oversized plans as dry-run events.

execution_skill_strategy.future_write_path: must pass through this wrapper with explicit non-dry-run approval, audit, tests, and contract update

non_goals: Do not enable raw obsidian-cli access.
Do not enable arbitrary shell execution.
Do not execute write, delete, rename, or move operations against vault files in Phase 3.
Do not parse web pages with defuddle until it is exposed through a controlled wrapper adapter.
Do not require a native Obsidian plugin.
